visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair is in an indoor home setting, holding a compact white USB-powered fan. He points to the USB-A connector of the device while speaking to the camera. Behind him is a shelf with headphones and personal items under soft indoor lighting. (2) The man inserts the USB fan into the top port of a silver Anker power bank. His hands are seen clearly in a medium close-up shot as he completes the connection. (3) He presses the power button on the side of the power bank, causing the fan blades to spin rapidly. He holds the assembly steady, showing the digital battery indicator on the power bank displaying 100%. (4) The camera angle shifts to a top-down view of the man sitting on a wooden floor. He is holding the fan nozzle against the inflation valve of a large yellow air mattress, attempting to fill it with air. (5) The man returns to the eye-level close-up, holding the fan and power bank again. He rotates the device to show the non-adjustable neck and continues his explanation, gesturing with his left hand to emphasize specific product details.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: USB 供電. [Slogan]: 強力小風扇. [Subtitle]: 這是一個威力加強版的. (2) [Subtitle]: USB 供電的小風扇. (3) [Subtitle]: 它是 USB 的 A 口. (4) [Subtitle]: 接上你的行動電源. (5) [Subtitle]: 按壓這邊有一個開關. (6) [Subtitle]: 一段是 1W 功率. (7) [Subtitle]: 兩段是 2W. (8) [Subtitle]: 第三段呢. (9) [Subtitle]: 是 8W 左右. (10) [Subtitle]: 以小風扇來說. (11) [Subtitle]: 它的功率算強. (12) [Subtitle]: 帶個小缺點就是它前面這個口啊. (13) [Subtitle]: 它只能是吹風. (14) [Subtitle]: 不適合來打氣. (15) [Subtitle]: 它沒有任何轉換套件. (16) [Subtitle]: 然後它壓力不夠強. (17) [Subtitle]: 我試過拿來打. (18) [Subtitle]: 單人床墊其實不太成功. (19) [Subtitle]: 在他這個頭啊. (20) [Subtitle]: 這個轉你看這邊是不能移動的. (21) [Subtitle]: 所以不能說你放在這. (22) [Subtitle]: 可以調整一下高低. (23) [Subtitle]: 吹你的臉或缺其他位置啊. (24) [Subtitle]: 有黑白兩色. (25) [Subtitle]: 但是質感、功率、外形來說算是. (26) [Subtitle]: 做的很不錯. (27) [Subtitle]: 就是幫你背包裏面做隨身備用. (28) [Subtitle]: 加上用電就是一個強力小風扇.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male speaker's voice in a standard indoor room environment. His tone is friendly and informative, speaking with a moderate pace. (2) A clear mechanical click is heard when he activates the power bank. This is immediately followed by a low-pitched whirring sound as the USB fan starts to spin. (3) The fan noise increases in intensity and spectral brightness as he switches through power levels, eventually settling into a loud, steady white-noise whir that partially masks the background room tone. (4) During the mattress demonstration, the speaker continues talking over the steady hum of the fan, accompanied by the distinct rustling and crinkling of plastic/fabric as the yellow mattress is handled. (5) The fan noise ceases, and the audio concludes with the speaker's closing remarks in a quiet, low-arousal indoor environment.
